QUOTE: "`scope` (`file_count`, `extensions`, `not_indexed`) | Exactly which files were read. Here: 426 files, with `.rs`, `.toml`, `.sql`, `.lock`, `.csv`, `.jsonl`, `.motor` and extensionless files left out." and "Term lives in an extension listed under `not_indexed`: no confidence. The reply names those files"

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer says the reply names the file types that were not indexed (`not_indexed`) and the extensions that were read. It never says the reply lists the in-scope file types that produced no rows. The item needs that list of in-scope types with zero hits, and the answer gives the opposite one.
